create_BinMapper: create a _BinMapper transformer that maps continuous and categorical features into integer-valued bins using quantile thresholds
fit_BinMapper: fit a _BinMapper on training data to compute binning thresholds for each feature
transform_BinMapper: transform data using a fitted _BinMapper to map feature values into integer bins with missing values in the last bin
find_binning_thresholds: find binning thresholds for a single continuous feature column using quantiles or unique value midpoints
make_known_categories_bitsets: make known category bitsets from a fitted _BinMapper for efficient categorical feature validation
